description: Get the company's SMS add-on status: whether SMS is enabled, plan eligibility, credit balance, brand prefix, phone numbers (each with linkShorteningEnabled), and whether SMS steps will actually send. Check this before adding SMS steps to sequences so you can warn the user when SMS is not ready.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_sms_settings

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sms_settings` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sms.description: SMS add-on status: enabled, planEligible, creditsBalance, brandPrefix (account-wide default), numbers (each with id, e164, label tag, brandPrefix override, linkShorteningEnabled, status), readyToSend (paid plan or credits plus an active number).

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
